63/S1/F0.text: Computer vision is an enabling technology with huge potential for building better applications in augmented reality (AR) and mixed reality (MR).

63/S1/F1.text: Cloud and edge computing concepts are relevant for scalable and affordable extended reality systems and for addressing resource optimization concerns.

63/S1/F2.text: Machine learning and deep learning concepts are currently ubiquitous for building better experiences and more intelligent systems in extended reality.

63/S1/F3.text: Large language models (LLMs) or generative artificial intelligence (AI) can be used for enhanced interactivity in extended reality applications.

63/S1/F4.text: Internet of Things (IoT), robotics, and blockchain technology are relevant technologies for extended reality applications.
